meta.description: Predicts whether a DNA variant alters mRNA splicing with SpliceAI, Pangolin, MMSplice, SpliceTransformer, CI-SpliceAI, SpliceVault and CADD-Splice; applies the ClinGen SVI 2023 PVS1/PP3/BP4 framework as research-use evidence, HGVS splicing nomenclature, extended-window deep-intronic scoring, branchpoint caveats and an ASO design checklist.
meta.audit_type: re-audit of a fixed Skill (fix branch fix/as-spvp)
meta.executed_inputs: 9/9 executed (input 6 partial: BPHunter and other branchpoint tools not run; SpliceTransformer/CI-SpliceAI/CADD ran in the fixer-staged envs, installs checked by dry-run only)
meta.inputs_note: 7 regression inputs (the pre-fix inputs, re-run) + 2 new inputs of the auditor's own (8, 9); n_inputs 9 exceeds the schema's documented 8 on purpose.
meta.environment: WSL science: as-spliceai (SpliceAI 1.3.1, TF 2.21), as-pangolin (Pangolin 1.0.2, torch 2.13 CPU), as-mmsplice (MMSplice 2.4.0), as-spvp (pandas 2.3.3, pysam, torch cpu, used for all parser/concordance tests and SpliceVault), as-cispliceai (CI-SpliceAI 1.2.2), as-spvp-gpu (torch 2.11+cu128, RTX 5070 Ti: SpliceTransformer 11 rows in 56 s). Windows Python not used. No existing package version changed; only a throwaway venv in WSL /tmp for the install check.
meta.truth_sets: Regression: the pre-fix GRCh37 chrX panel (REF asserted vs X.fa) and TP53 GRCh38. New (auditor-built, REF asserted vs hg38 FASTA, 0 mismatches): the same panel lifted to GRCh38 with Ensembl REST /map, a CFTR/BRCA1 panel from Ensembl VEP HGVS and ClinVar SPDI (3849+10kbC>T pseudoexon, 5 canonical/near-site acceptor and donor variants, 6 likely-benign), DMD splice-site variants picked by seeded random from GENCODE v45. Reference: GENCODE v45 chr17+chrX GTF (a verified md5-identical subset of the release), UCSC hg38 chr7/chr17/chrX upper-cased. Fixer data used as inputs only after independent checks (GTF subset md5, lifted coordinates equal to the fixer panel).

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated numbers: every quoted score, mask-table cell, SpliceVault event and PHRED value reproduced (or was checked against the source); citations sampled against Crossref (SpliceVault Nat Genet 55:324, SpliceAI Cell 176:535, Pangolin Genome Biol 23, SpliceTransformer Nat Commun 15); the 884 MB SpliceVault size equals Content-Length; the BPHunter 404 claim is true (page redirects to a GitHub 404).

practice_boundaries.detail: Scope paragraph and usage-guide sentence state research-use decision support and forbid patient write-ups; SpliceAI alone is not PVS1; concordance labels renamed (no "pathogenic" anywhere in output labels); ASO section relabelled a checklist. The pre-fix caveats are closed.

methodological_ground.detail: Thresholds are ClinGen SVI 2023 at supporting weight, boundaries inclusive, unscored records never read as benign; the -D mechanism and Pangolin mask trade-off are now measured and correct. Residual: no warning that concordant false positives exist (CFTR c.2909-10T>G) - P2.

code_usability.detail: RE-JUDGED FROM FAIL. All 12 fenced blocks of SKILL.md parse (ast / bash -n, out/m4_blocks.log) and were run: install lines resolve (dry-run) and the Pangolin clone installs pangolin + create_db.py; SpliceAI, Pangolin (create_db.py + both masks), tissue script, SpliceVault, MMSplice, SpliceTransformer, CI-SpliceAI, CADD, -D 500 and the parser/concordance blocks ran and printed asserted values; the two pre-fix P0 recipes (Pangolin DB/dependencies, concordance snippet) now run on real GRCh37 and GRCh38 output; the shipped example runs end to end on three VCFs. Only a batch containing a symbolic <DEL> aborts the example (documented crash, P1, not a usability failure of the primary path).

recommendations.title: Shipped example aborts on one symbolic ALT
recommendations.problem: spliceai_clingen_classify.py runs SpliceAI with check=True; one <DEL> record makes SpliceAI exit 1 and the example prints a CalledProcessError traceback with no output for the other records.
recommendations.root_cause: The example does not pre-filter records that SpliceAI cannot write, although SKILL.md documents the crash.
recommendations.fix: Filter ALT alleles starting with "<" (and "*") into an unscored list before the run, or run per-record on failure, and report them in the not_scored warnings.

recommendations.title: Extended-window recipe does not recover the named CFTR example
recommendations.problem: CFTR c.3849+10kbC>T (c.3717+12191C>T), listed in the Skill as a disease example, scores SpliceAI 0.16 at -D 50, 500 and 2000; only Pangolin (+0.33) and the discordance label flag it, CI-SpliceAI gives 0.01, MMSplice returns no row.
recommendations.root_cause: The Failure Mode text reads as if -D 500 is the fix; the measured GLA case is favourable, this one is not.
recommendations.fix: Add the CFTR measurement next to the GLA one and say that a deep-intronic candidate at 0.10-0.20 with a Pangolin gain is a "discordant, needs RNA" case, not a rescue by -D.

recommendations.title: Gene column shows overlapping gene
recommendations.problem: per_variant() keeps the highest-delta gene, so OTC c.386+5G>A appears as RP5-972B16.2 and GLA benign variants as RPL36A-HNRNPH2.
recommendations.fix: Prefer the gene named in the VCF/MANE transcript or add a second column listing all annotated genes.

recommendations.title: Concordance labels can overstate weak agreement
recommendations.problem: GLA c.639+919G>A is all_predict_disruption from two tools at 0.30/0.23, and CFTR c.2909-10T>G (ClinVar likely benign) is concordant across three tools plus CI-SpliceAI.
recommendations.root_cause: Label is a count over thresholds; no warning that concordance is not immunity from false positives at -10 acceptor positions.
recommendations.fix: Show the margin above threshold or n_scored next to the label in the table, and add one sentence that concordant calls still need ClinVar/gnomAD and RNA evidence.

recommendations.title: Mask table omits a further erased loss; keys carry full REF sequences
recommendations.problem: With the canonical DB, -m True also erased the PLCXD1 donor loss (-0.80 -> 0.00); a 150-bp deletion prints its whole REF in keys and warnings.
recommendations.root_cause: Table lists the fixer's cases only; variant_key() uses raw REF/ALT.
recommendations.fix: Add the PLCXD1 row (or "any site absent from the canonical DB"); truncate long alleles in printed keys.

recommendations.title: Installs only partly verifiable; heavy SKILL.md
recommendations.problem: torch via pip pulls the CUDA wheel by default, SpliceTransformer needs a Drive download and pyensembl indexing that I could not repeat from scratch; SKILL.md is still 443 lines with no references/ layer.
recommendations.root_cause: Recipes were verified in the fixer's envs; restructuring was declared out of scope.
recommendations.fix: Add a CPU-torch note and pin the GitHub commits; move ASO, branchpoint and HGVS material to references/.
